scope: Frontend prompt preparation, cancellation, queue retention and admission-result races; ARCH-25–ARCH-30 / P03 subset only.
provenance: Results are summaries of actual exec tool output from this task. No original log file was retained for these runs; this JSON is not a reconstructed raw log.
sourceIdentityBoundary: File hashes identify the working tree when this receipt was written, not a complete frozen snapshot of each earlier red or green run.

findings.observedFailure: Stopping while attachment validation, draft persistence or archive activity persistence awaited left running=false and stopping=true permanently. No session_prompt had been dispatched, so no completion receipt could settle the stop; the timer skipped a no-longer-running request.
findings.fix: Track only in-memory preparation with a WeakSet. A local stop pauses and preserves queued input without sending session_cancel. Submission remains guarded until the preflight completes. Remove preparation marker immediately before session_prompt dispatch.
findings.coverage: Three awaited preparation stages for both draft and established conversations; original attachment and later queued input retained; no phantom prompt/cancel; explicit continue sends original once.

findings.observedFailure: Stopping after session_prompt dispatch but before explicit rejected admission left stopping or stopUnconfirmed set, although that prompt could not later complete.
findings.fix: Only an explicit rejected admission retires its stop timer and stopping/stopUnconfirmed state. Existing independent connection-outcome protection is not cleared.
findings.coverage: Successful and failed cancellation reply, with delayed explicit work_disabled rejection; both queued inputs retained.

redRuns.assertion: Expected stopping=false; actual stopping=true after cancellation and preflight completion.
redRuns.commandNote: Full original command and raw output were not retained as files; contemporaneous task summary records three failing preparation-stage cases.

redRuns.stage: After preparation fix; before rejected-admission fix
coverage: explicit rejection after cancellation reply failure
redRuns.assertion: Actual stopping=true in acknowledgement case, or stopUnconfirmed=true after cancellation reply failure.
redRuns.commandNote: Full original command and raw output were not retained as files; contemporaneous task summary records both failures.

greenRuns.stage: After both fixes and initial boundary coverage
greenRuns.note: Superseded by final 129-test run after two additional unknown-admission stop cases.

preservedBoundaries: After actual dispatch, a cancellation acknowledgement is not prompt completion. The delayed accepted-admission test remains protected after the 30-second stop timeout until a real cancelled turnEnd is delivered.
Unknown admission and lost IPC reply while stopping retain uncertainPrompt, connectionOutcomeUnknown and stopUnconfirmed. Explicit continue does not dispatch either queued input again.
Tests mock Tauri calls, persistence boundaries and timing; no real Agent, account, model, external service or installed application was invoked.
No source outside the three listed frontend files was modified by this subtask; no new persistent ledger, contract change, application replacement or commit.

This proves the controlled frontend races only. It does not establish 29-Agent acceptance, installed UI behavior, full stop/recovery coverage or a fix for historical external commands surviving cancellation.
Full seven-check integration is a separate parent-run verification and is not claimed by this receipt.
